purpose: Freeze sampled three-level quintic-Hermite reconstruction geometry and non-interpolation residual probes for the completed N384/M384 piecewise archive.

design_basis.requirement: Three actual accepted-node support triples per probe, with strictly nested support intervals and strictly decreasing node spacings; residual probes are off interpolation nodes and quarter-stage clocks; evaluate residual through a separately implemented conservative 2N product path.

resource_accounting.n768_conservative_residual_workspace_tot: unplanned; must be separately preflighted as a multi-field workspace

required_future_inputs: For every selected actual node, obtain or independently recompute and hash all three physical-time RHS derivative spectra under the exact archived identity. The archive currently retains state values and hashes, not derivative spectra.
Stream and verify only the selected remote state files against the archive manifest under a bounded reader; do not assume all 48 state payloads are locally available.

Preflight a fresh independently implemented conservative N768 product/residual path, its force evaluation, all output scratch, finite work, and artifact capacity. Existing observer768 measurements are not this independent path.

generic_review_scope.current_partition_support: The generic diagnostic plan distinguishes a disjoint accepted-state schedule from a residual-only offstage schedule.
generic_review_scope.not_reusable_without_semantic_change: The shipped exact-v2 review adapter fixes seven events and exact-v2 family/profile semantics. Resizing its event count cannot bind this N384 archive's node triples, derivative hashes, or N768 product provenance.
generic_review_scope.required_artifact_shape: A dedicated N384 archival manifest must retain separate accepted_state_clocks and offstage_residual_clocks, every coarse/middle/fine node triple, state and derivative hashes, and conservative-product identity.
generic_review_scope.acceptance: No consumer, residual measurement, generic-review rewrite, acceptance determination, or PDE qualification is created by this design.
